tenderSchedule.description: Providing Manpower Services on Out Source Basis to Tumkur University, Tumakuru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: All technical evaluation criteria as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Achieved a minimum financial turnover of Rs 801.46 Lakhs in any 02 financial year out of last 05 years,2020-21 to 2024-25
Bank Solvency certificate/Letter of Credit for Rs. 101.88 lakhs issued by the recognized Banks. copy to be enclosed
Details of Registration with the Labour Department for having 133 labours,copy to be to be enclosed

Entity/ Firm Registration certificate issued by District Registrar / Certificate of Incorporation by the Registrar of the companies if it is company, certificate of Registration from the Registrar of Society if it is a co-operative society/ Certificate of the Registration from the Registrar of Companies if it is limited liability partnership/ trade license issued by the local authority

Experience/work done certificate for providing Man power Services to the Government / Semi Government organization, Universities / Public Sector under takings / in any one financial year out of last 5 years by the tendering firms. Certificate to be enclosed and the worth of service should not less than Rs. 200.36 Lakhs. Single Contract in a year
GST Registration certificate issued by competent authority,copy to be enclosed
Income Tax returns for the year 2020-21 to 2024-25
License from the Authority under the Contract Labour Regulation and Abolition Act 1970.
Self Declaration Rs. 500-00 Non-Judicial Stamp Paper certified by the Notary to be submitted stating that the entity has not been black listed by any Government and Non-Governmental Departments.
Upload all other documents as per tender document
